scope: Persisted source run identity, bounded execution summary and read-only UI for the three existing aspects
criteria: A run binds scenario id, start/end, plan and source lock hashes
A running or failed attempt never inherits the previous run amounts
Skipped or pending targets never bind old execution files
Actual target counts are distinct from generated counts; execution summary retains a source hash
True zeros, masking states, per-source balances and evidence parts remain distinct in the UI
Request errors, scenario switch and old report formats clear displayed previous results
Sources disabled removes the latest report; invalid preflight creates no run
Browser success/failure views use an isolated backend and synthetic inputs
limits: Latest run only; no archive or transactional run repository
No automatic match against all current scenario inputs or later upload changes
Private/parcel source migration, real city/rural evidence and scientific freight fallback remain open
